One or Many?

Plurals: Round-Up 1

Rule 1 Add -s

Tap a card: one → many. Tap again to go back.

Rule 1 Add -s: more animals

Tap a card: one → many.

Rule 1 Add -s: food

Tap a card: one → many.

Rule 1 Add -s: things

Tap a card: one → many.

Rule 2 s, ss, sh, ch, x, o → add -es

Hard ending? Add -es! BUT: radio → radios, piano → pianos.

Rule 3 Consonant + y → -ies

Consonant before y: change y to i + es.

Rule 3b Vowel + y → just add -s

a, e, i, o, u before y? Keep the y!

Rule 4 f / fe → -ves

Remove -f / -fe and add -ves. BUT: giraffe → giraffes.

Special! Irregular plurals

No rule. We learn them by heart.

Game: Sort the words!

Tap a word, then tap the right box.

Well done!
